# 0005: Theme = tokens + component variants

Date: 2026-11-24 · Status: accepted

**Context.** Each app needs a distinct look generated by `/new-app`, without forking components.
Colour-only theming makes every app look the same.

**Decision.**
- Tokens for colour, shape (radius, border width), density (control height, surface padding), depth and motion live in `src/styles/theme.css`, and fonts in `src/config/fonts.ts`.
- shadcn components (Base UI flavour, the current shadcn default) were rewired to read them (`h-control`, `border-ui`, `shadow-surface`, …).
- Deeper personality goes into `cva` variants. `/styleguide` is the visual check, and axe runs on it in CI.

**Consequences.** Adding a shadcn component means rewiring its sizes and borders to tokens before use.
See `docs/theming.md`.
